  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: Redirecting the two Semble-related `::warning::` echoes to stderr prevents GitHub Actions from surfacing them as workflow annotations.
  WHY: Four reviewers reported the loss of UI annotation visibility; deepseek and qwen disputed that it is a bug, but the only impact described is reduced operator visibility, so low severity fits the disagreement.

  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: `_log_semble_event` emits space-separated `key=value` fields without quoting, so values containing spaces become ambiguous to downstream parsers.
  WHY: x-ai and z-ai both pointed to `reason`/`stderr_tail` content containing spaces, and z-ai also tied the same parsing bug to the `reason` construction at 350-353.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:140-144 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: `_log_semble_event` emits unquoted space-separated `key=value` fields, so multi-word telemetry values are ambiguous to downstream parsers.
  WHY: Both reviewers identified the same structured-logging fragility at this location; moonshot assigned ISSUE_CONFIDENCE 3.
